spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (हठति)
1 To leap or jump.
2 To be wicked.
3 To treat with violence, to oppress.
4 To bind to a post.

Rapine.
mf. (-ठः-ठी)
An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.)
E.
हठ to treat with violence, aff. अच्.

f. (-र्णी)
An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria octandra.)
E.
हठ Pistia, and पर्ण a leaf.

m. (-लुः)
An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes.)
E.
हठ the same, and आलु a root.
